title: Oyster Extract for Hair: Zinc, Evidence & What to Know
seo_title: Oyster Extract for Hair: Zinc, Evidence & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: Why oyster extract comes up for hair (zinc), what a 2023 review and a 2025 study found about zinc and hair loss, and what hasn't been tested.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (1,869 words, 0 study links) claimed oyster extract strengthens follicles and prevents hair loss. Removed; rewritten around zinc evidence, labelled as mixed.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
No oyster-extract hair study exists. The article is about zinc evidence and says so.
Shellfish-allergy caution in the safety FAQ is general advice, not from an abstract.

'Lean beef, beef liver, dark poultry meat, egg yolk and cheese are also high' comes from the Murphy 1975 abstract (beef liver, dark poultry, egg yolk, Cheddar cheese); check wording if you want it exact.
